subject: general
question: When was ‘Vayudoot’ airline setup in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1981**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vayudoot__

 __
 
• It was a regional airline in India **established in 1981**.
 
• It is a joint venture between** Indian Airlines and Air India.**
 
• It was headquartered at New Delhi's Safdarjung Airport.
 
• The airline was primarily used to serve the Northeastern part of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Air India__

 __
 
• It is the flag carrier airline of India.
 
• It is headquartered in New Delhi.
 
• It is owned by a Special-Purpose Vehicle of Tata Sons known as 'Talace Private Limited'.
 
• It operates Airbus and Boeing aircraft to serve 102 domestic and international destinations.
 
• The airline was founded by J.R.D. Tata as Tata Airlines in 1932.
 
 
 
• Indian Airlines__
 
 
• The airline became a division of Air India Limited.
 
• It is after the merger of eight pre-Independence domestic airlines.
 
• The airline is based in Delhi.
